name: Emer Harris
role: Early elder and older brother of Martin Harris
dateNote: He was baptized on 10 February 1831, and section 75 named him for a mission on 25 January 1832.
importance: Emer Harris grew up near Palmyra and was baptized in Pennsylvania in February 1831. In October 1831 he was ordained a high priest and served briefly as a scribe to Joseph Smith. Section 75 unites him in the ministry with Simeon Carter. He worked on the Kirtland and Nauvoo temples, moved to Utah, and was ordained a patriarch in 1853.
connections: He was an older brother of Martin Harris. His named companion is Simeon Carter (75:30).

sources.title: Emer Harris, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and roles checked on JSP; death 28 Nov. 1869 read from a cut fragment. JSP does not list siblings; the Martin Harris link follows the batch note and is widely stated, but I did not confirm it on a page I loaded.
